# Groq Free as a distinct replacement route (26 September 2026)

**Disposition: failed the fixed current-product scientific prerequisite; not qualified.** This external service screen is not evidence about Google's Co-Scientist. A bounded interface screen and one scientific trial ran on the Free account. No model default or production deployment changed.

The owner's existing Groq organization visibly has the **Free ($0)** plan. Its **Inference APIs ZDR** control was disabled and was enabled on 26 September; a subsequent readback showed it enabled. Global ZDR and the Batch/Fine-tuning controls were left unchanged. Two newly created, unused 30-day keys were revoked after their handoff failed. The owner then created a replacement campaign key and copied it for secure transfer. It is stored outside the repository in a local mode-0600 file; existing unrelated keys were untouched. A credentialed read-only `GET /openai/v1/models` returned HTTP 200 and listed `openai/gpt-oss-120b`. That GET alone verifies access, not inference behavior, account billing, or scientific suitability. Do not put a key or account identifier in this repository.

Official documentation for `openai/gpt-oss-120b` lists a 131,072-token context, 65,536-token maximum completion, structured output, tool calling, streaming, and a Free-plan allowance of 30 requests/minute, 1,000 requests/day, 8,000 tokens/minute, and 200,000 tokens/day. [Models](https://console.groq.com/docs/models), [rate limits](https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits), [structured outputs](https://console.groq.com/docs/structured-outputs). Structured output cannot share one request with tool calling or streaming; the present app uses those shapes in separate calls. Groq says inference data is normally not retained and that enabling Inference APIs ZDR opts out of its otherwise possible reliability/abuse logging. [Data controls](https://console.groq.com/docs/your-data). The current Free plan is a billing property of this account, not a per-request zero-price cap. A later account upgrade would invalidate the campaign's zero-spend admission, so any use needs a fresh plan/ZDR readback and must stop on 429 rather than falling through to a paid path.

The provisional test-first adapter at qualification commit `41c76bda` admitted only `groq/openai/gpt-oss-120b` as a system/default free route and pinned `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1`. Every system-configured `groq/*` model entered its free gate; explicit user BYOK remained separate. Its guard rejected fallbacks and unqualified request options while admitting the app's streaming shape. That adapter was removed after the scientific failure, before merge or deployment. The retained artifacts identify the historical code and protocol revisions.

In that historical snapshot, each non-BYOK Groq request required a current-date, key-specific `COSCIENTIST_GROQ_FREE_ZDR_ATTESTATION`. It was an operator assertion about Free/ZDR account state, not provider-authenticated billing evidence and not protection against a same-day plan upgrade. The Free quotas are still unproven for a complete research run; the Express 1,200-call setting is a runaway backstop, not an observed call count.

The [interface screen](groq-interface-2026-09-26-1.json) passed all four cases in five calls. A [zero-call preflight failure](groq-batch-2026-09-26-trial-1.json) exposed a validator defect, corrected without repeating the interface calls. The [first completed scientific trial](groq-batch-2026-09-26-trial-1-live.json) used one call and failed the preregistered actual-interface label sequence: the existing contradiction provenance guard downgraded a short model quote. Trials two and three were not launched. The fixed configuration is unqualified, but this result does not establish general model incapability. See the [protocol](groq-free-qualification-prereg-v1.json) and [qualification index](README.md).

An independent read-only diagnosis on 26 September compared the frozen fourth claim, the model's raw verdict and quote, and the maintained guard. The full source really contradicts the claim about treatment S, fibroblast migration and 24 hours. The model returned `contradicts` but cited only `it decreased migration`, a pronoun-dependent fragment that omits the subject and conditions despite the batch prompt's self-contained-quote instruction. The guard correctly downgraded that fragment to `insufficient`; its existing tests also preserve genuine on-topic negations and reject off-target or merely confirmatory passages. No guard correction or repeat of the failed frozen trial is justified. The protocol also asked for `model_primary` on the final contradiction, whereas accepted contradictions receive `lexical_founded` or `model_opposition_verified`; that subcriterion is structurally unreachable, but the independent exact-label failure already decides this trial. Preserve the historical protocol and artifact unchanged; correct this criterion only in a newly frozen protocol for a materially different candidate.
